notes: Product-scoped candidate for LBank Earn, including Spot Earn and Locked products but not generic spot trading. The reviewed sources establish operation by November/December 2025 but do not establish the original umbrella Earn launch date, so canonical launch_date should remain null. The current Earn Service Agreement says the service does not provide principal protection, users may face partial or total principal loss, LBank may aggregate user assets, and users authorize the platform to pledge, lend, provide liquidity, hedge or otherwise use assets to generate returns. Spot Earn guidance separately says post-subsidy yield comes from arbitrage strategies executed by professional quantitative institutions; this should not be generalized to every Locked or other Earn product.
